acceptance_question: Does the Current learner surface faithfully project accepted Mao Logic and exam-useful content with the right information hierarchy, while Chengfeng remains the external-primary continuous study surface?

chapter_dispositions.defect: C04-S01 owns four parallel `answers[]` in accepted Content, but the generic projection adapter only mapped singular answer/core_answer/evaluation, so the learner-facing core answer disappeared.
chapter_dispositions.repair: Add a Mao-scoped projection adapter that preserves plural answers only when generic teaching.answer is empty. Accepted C04 Content/Logic remains unchanged.

whole_subject.strongest_attack: Backend completeness must not be confused with learner-surface completeness. The audit specifically searched for accepted core problems/answers that disappear in the generic adapter, as well as the opposite failure where rich content_support would be dumped into the first-round surface.
surface_findings: Chapter orientation foregrounds the chapter problem, answer, sequence and attention rule.
Natural Unit foregrounds the current problem and core answer; relation/hierarchy/application remain progressively disclosed.
content_support is not rendered wholesale into the generic first-round page.
Chengfeng is explicitly handed off to iPad/MarginNote and continuous source text is not copied into Astro.
20-second closure is a collapsible tool rather than a mandatory blocking ritual.
Xiao1000 remains downstream verification and does not organize first-learning order.
Chapter compression remains subordinate to the learning path.

negative_space: Projection PASS does not mean every backend exact list should be visible immediately.
Projection PASS does not accept Mao-specific Runtime or Evidence semantics.
Projection PASS does not make closure/Recall mandatory after every Natural Unit.
Projection PASS does not move continuous Chengfeng reading into Astro.
Projection PASS does not manufacture U or learner progress.
